verses.gurmukhi: ਹਰਦੀ ਅਉ ਚੂਨਾ ਮਿਲਿ ਅਰੁਨ ਬਰਨ ਜੈਸੇ ਚਤੁਰ ਬਰਨ ਕੈ ਤੰਬੋਲ ਰਸ ਰੂਪ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: haradhee aau choonaa mil arun baran jaise chatur baran kai ta(n)bol ras roop hai ||

en.bdb: As turmeric and lime when mixed produce red colour, but when betel leaf, lime, betelnut and catechu are all brought together, a very deep red colour is produced;

verses.gurmukhi: ਦੂਧ ਮੈ ਜਾਮਨ ਮਿਲੈ ਦਧਿ ਕੈ ਬਖਾਨੀਅਤ ਖਾਂਡ ਘ੍ਰਿਤ ਚੂਨ ਮਿਲਿ ਬਿੰਜਨ ਅਨੂਪ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: dhoodh mai jaaman milai dhadh kai bakhaaneeat khaa(n)dd ghirat choon mil bi(n)jan anoop hai ||

en.bdb: As a small cogulent added to the milk set it as curd but sugar, flour and clarified butter produces a very tasty dish;

verses.gurmukhi: ਕੁਸਮ ਸੁਗੰਧ ਮਿਲਿ ਤਿਲ ਸੈ ਫੁਲੇਲ ਹੋਤ ਸਕਲ ਸੁਗੰਧ ਮਿਲਿ ਅਰਗਜਾ ਧੂਪ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: kusam suga(n)dh mil til sai fulel hot sakal suga(n)dh mil aragajaa dhoop hai ||

en.bdb: An extract of flowers when mixed with sesame oil become scented oil, but mixing of saffron musk, sandalwood and rose make a very fragrant product called argaja;

verses.gurmukhi: ਦੋਇ ਸਿਖ ਸਾਧ ਸੰਗੁ ਪੰਚ ਪਰਮੇਸਰ ਹੈ ਦਸ ਬੀਸ ਤੀਸ ਮਿਲੇ ਅਬਿਗਤਿ ਊਪ ਹੈ ॥੧੨੨॥
verses.translit_en: dhoi sikh saadh sa(n)g pa(n)ch paramesar hai dhas bees tees mile abigat uoop hai ||122||

en.bdb: So would two Sikhs together make a holy congregation while five of them would represent the Lord. But where ten, twenty or thirty like-minded Sikhs engrossed in the love of the Guru meet, their praise is beyond description. (122)
